title: Google Summer of Code
description: Global program where contributors work on open-source software projects with mentorship from participating organizations.
eligibility: Generally open to beginners in open source who meet the program requirements. Check official eligibility.

title: Google Developer Groups
description: Join local developer communities to attend workshops, networking events, hackathons and technical sessions.
eligibility: Open to students and developers interested in Google technologies.

title: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors
description: Student leadership program that helps students build technical, leadership and community skills.
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in an accredited academic institution. Check official requirements.

title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
description: Access free developer tools, cloud credits and learning resources for eligible students.
eligibility: Verified students meeting GitHub Education requirements.

title: NVIDIA Student Network
description: Student-focused AI learning community with access to resources, projects and networking opportunities.
eligibility: Check the official NVIDIA Student Network requirements.
